## Batch completion event
Select your Transglot credential on both nodes. Requires webhook access, manage ability, and a publicly reachable n8n webhook URL.

Activation creates a subscription; deactivation removes it. The trigger verifies the HMAC signature, timestamp and selected event before starting the workflow. After upgrading from 0.1.0, deactivate and reactivate the workflow to retain its signing secret.

Batch completion does not mean translations are human-approved. Repeated valid deliveries within five minutes are not deduplicated. See the package README for static-data handling and delivery-ID deduplication guidance.

Inactive example with no credentials.
